name: Lucky Orange

evidence.replay: F02: primary job is website behavior analytics; F17: DOM-based session recordings and dynamic heatmaps
evidence.web: F15: pageviews, unique visitors, traffic source, UTM campaigns, country and device filters
evidence.product: F16: ordered URL or event funnels with at least two steps, and developer-defined events

line: Records website sessions with heatmaps, funnels, and form analytics.

free.text: Free: 100 sessions/month, 1 site, 30-day history; pauses at limit

cells.cookieless: No, uses first-party cookies and local storage

pv.math: Billed by sessions. The free plan covers 100 a month. Build starts at $39 a month, but the listed session limits conflict: 3,500 and 5,000.
